command_or_source: App commit 763fdaafb43976b33613989140a9acb0338cd681: bash scripts/test.sh (CLI not-running branch, unknown command consumption, dedupe-on-command behavior).
result_summary: CLI reports a clear non-zero error when the app is not running; unknown WeChat commands are consumed exactly once with a local failure notification and do not block the listener; command messages are recorded in dedupe state before execution so failures do not retry.
limitations: IPC mid-stream interruption and timeout are covered by the not-running/early-EOF path and code review rather than a live socket drop test.
Duplicate command delivery is asserted via dedupe key behavior, not a repeated live getupdates batch.
